variable.armor.note: 0-2 - green, blue, red. Drives the heart tint.
variable.countdown-active.note: 0 or 1 - the digging game or a Super Bomb is counting down.
variable.countdown-frames.note: Frames left inside the current second, 0-61. 0 while none runs.
variable.countdown-seconds.note: Whole seconds left on the countdown. 0 while none runs.
variable.key-current.note: Small keys for the current dungeon. 0-99.
variable.life-current.note: Eighths - one heart is 8. 0 to life_max.
variable.magic-current.note: Raw magic power. 0-128, a full bar.
variable.magic-max.note: Constant 128 today; present so a layout never hard-codes it.
variable.slot-count.note: How many slots the active scheme has.
